scope: Immutable baseline of the S2-002 evidence records that existed BEFORE the SpaceDazher/Veritas#41 fix. These four run/comparison records are rewritten by design whenever npm run verify:s2-002 runs, so they cannot be pinned in frozen-manifest.json the way the other four are. This file is the fixed point: a rewrite of any of them that is not an explicit, reviewed re-baseline is drift, whether or not evidence/root-manifest.json was re-frozen in the same commit.
rebaselineRequires: An explicit change to this file, reviewed as a deliberate re-baseline. Re-freezing evidence/root-manifest.json does NOT rebaseline it.
